notes: Stack tracking: components that drop as 4/5/6/7 now group into one row with a stack-size distribution chart and average quantity. Item names are normalised (stack counts stripped, plurals singularised) since clients report the same item under different names. Fixes difficulty being polluted by loot rarity - DifficultyType also carries Common/Uncommon/Rare/Named values, which split a single run into bogus pools.
